svg.title: From a benefits denial to an applied correction
svg.desc: Six steps in the reference example, with three failure points. A named person remains responsible throughout. The final inspection is a recommended check of the returned result.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 9px;fill: rgb(7%,49%,50%); stroke:none;

g.text: A named person remains responsible for the case throughout
